    dim_region.state_code AS 客户所在州代码,

ORDER BY dim_region.state_code ASC;

cases.question: 对比2018年4月和5月已送达与已取消订单的数量
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    fact_order.status AS 订单状态,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fact_order.purchase_date >= '2018-04-01' AND fact_order.purchase_date <= '2018-04-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 2018年4月订单数量,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fact_order.purchase_date >= '2018-05-01' AND fact_order.purchase_date <= '2018-05-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 2018年5月订单数量
FROM fact_order
WHERE fact_order.status IN ('delivered', 'canceled')
    AND fact_order.purchase_date >= '2018-04-01'
    AND fact_order.purchase_date <= '2018-05-31'
GROUP BY fact_order.status
ORDER BY fact_order.status;
